title: Mem0
description: Adds retrievable long-term memories that persist across an agent's sessions, tools, and runs.

title: Letta
description: Supports stateful agents with persistent editable memory and background consolidation of lessons from prior conversations.

title: Graphiti
description: Builds temporal knowledge graphs from evolving interactions while retaining fact history and links to source episodes.

title: MemOS
description: Provides APIs to store, retrieve, edit, and delete persistent agent memory with asynchronous ingestion and feedback-based correction.

title: LangGraph
description: Uses persistent checkpoints and cross-thread stores to resume agent workflows and retain useful context across interactions.

title: Temporal
description: Preserves workflow execution state through failures so long-running background jobs can wait for events and resume work.

title: Inngest
description: Triggers asynchronous background functions from application events, webhooks, or recurring schedules for ongoing agent workflows.

title: Composio
description: Connects agents to user-authorized app accounts and delivers app-event triggers that can start contextual background work.

title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: Standardizes connections to external data and tools so personal agents can access authorized context and invoke application capabilities.

title: Langfuse
description: Records agent traces and evaluation signals to inspect failures, latency, and costs across ongoing assistance workflows.
